what a failing M0 is doing: not emitting an even-length hex token as its bytes
treating spaces, tabs or newlines as anything but token separators
not ending a comment at end of line, or emitting comment text
ending a comment at a lone CR (only LF ends it)
emitting bytes for a multi-character label
not expanding a macro to its body bytes at each use
not resolving a forward &NAME, or not counting its 4 bytes on the first pass
not emitting the output offset of a multi-character label
not computing rel32 = target - (here + 4) for a multi-character name
taking more than ONE token as the macro body (4a is the body; 4b is ordinary hex after it)
